name: KhelStream
tagline: Live cricket streaming where the last over brings the most viewers
summary: KhelStream streams live cricket to phones and TVs: login and device limits, subscriptions, payments, playback sessions, DRM licences, the CDN, server-side ads, the live scorecard and chat. A World Cup final brings twenty times a normal match's viewers in the last overs. Streams that will not start at the toss, ads that cut into play and subscriptions that do not activate keep coming back.

tour.headline: Every playback start checks the subscription in the database, so the toss knocks over streams, licences and logins together; fixing it costs 20 hours.

incidents.title: Video failed to start for 12 minutes at the toss
incidents.desc: At 13:30 millions of viewers opened the match together and most saw 'Something went wrong' instead of video.
whys: Streams would not start at 13:30
Every start request waited on the entitlement database
Every playback start checks entitlement in the database
incidents.lesson: Replicas bought minutes, not a design.

incidents.title: Ad break cut off the first ball of the innings
incidents.desc: An ad break ran 40 seconds longer than the real break and viewers missed the first ball.
whys: Viewers missed the first ball
The ad break ran 40 seconds longer than the real break
Ad break length is hard-coded instead of read from the live signal
incidents.lesson: Breaks are never the same length twice.

incidents.title: Scorecard two overs behind the video
incidents.desc: The scorecard lagged the video by two overs during the chase.
whys: The scorecard lagged the video
The provider was polled every 30 seconds and requests queued up
The scorecard polls the data provider instead of receiving pushed updates
incidents.lesson: Polling faster made the provider throttle us.

incidents.title: Subscription bought at the toss not activated
incidents.desc: 2,600 viewers paid for a subscription at the toss but still saw 'Subscribe to watch'.
whys: Paid viewers could not watch
The payment success callback was lost
Subscription payments are not reconciled with the payment gateway
incidents.fix: Activated subscriptions from the gateway's report.
incidents.lesson: A lost callback means a paying customer who cannot watch.

incidents.title: Viewers logged out on all devices mid-match
incidents.desc: Viewers on TVs and phones were logged out during the chase and could not log in again for 10 minutes.
whys: Viewers were logged out
Device-limit checks failed with lock wait timeouts
Device-limit checks lock the user row on every heartbeat
incidents.lesson: Longer waits mean more blocked heartbeats.

incidents.title: Live chat froze when India won the toss
incidents.desc: Chat and reactions stopped updating for 6 minutes after the toss.
whys: Chat stopped updating
Every message was written in its own database transaction
Chat writes every message to the database in its own transaction

incidents.title: Licence errors for Android viewers at the start of the chase
incidents.desc: Android viewers saw 'licence error' for 9 minutes as the chase began.
whys: Android viewers saw licence errors
The licence server waited on entitlement lookups
Every playback start checks entitlement in the database
incidents.lesson: The licence server inherits every database problem.

incidents.title: Origin overloaded when live manifests bypassed the edge
incidents.desc: Viewers buffered for 8 minutes because every player fetched live manifests from the origin.
whys: Buffering for 8 minutes
Every viewer's player fetched manifests from the origin
Live manifests are not cached at the edge
incidents.lesson: The origin should never see every viewer.

incidents.title: Playback start failures during the super over
incidents.desc: The super over drew record viewers and new streams failed to start for 7 minutes.
whys: New streams would not start
Start requests queued behind entitlement queries
Every playback start checks entitlement in the database
incidents.lesson: The super over will not be the biggest night.

incidents.title: Ads overlapped live play after the strategic time-out
incidents.desc: After a strategic time-out, ads kept playing for 30 seconds after play resumed.
whys: Ads covered live play
The break length did not match the actual time-out
Ad break length is hard-coded instead of read from the live signal
incidents.fix: Cut the break short by hand.
incidents.lesson: Someone has to watch every break.

incidents.title: Paying subscribers asked to subscribe again
incidents.desc: During the toss, paying subscribers saw 'Subscribe to watch' because the entitlement lookup timed out.
whys: Subscribers saw 'Subscribe to watch'
The entitlement lookup timed out and defaulted to 'not subscribed'
Every playback start checks entitlement in the database
incidents.fix: Apologised and extended subscriptions by a day.

incidents.title: Toss-time subscriptions charged but not activated
incidents.desc: 1,100 viewers were charged at the toss but their subscriptions did not activate for an hour.
whys: Paid viewers could not watch
Gateway callbacks failed under load and were not retried
Subscription payments are not reconciled with the payment gateway
incidents.fix: Activated them from the gateway report again.

incidents.title: Reactions and chat lagged by 3 minutes in the final over
incidents.desc: Chat messages appeared 3 minutes late during the final over.
whys: Chat lagged by 3 minutes
Message writes queued behind each other
Chat writes every message to the database in its own transaction
incidents.lesson: A slow-mode is not a fix.

incidents.title: Mass logouts during the semi-final
incidents.desc: Thousands of viewers were logged out as device heartbeats blocked each other.
whys: Viewers were logged out
Heartbeats waited on locked user rows
Device-limit checks lock the user row on every heartbeat

incidents.title: Scorecard stuck on the 18th over
incidents.desc: The scorecard stopped at 17.6 overs while the match finished.
whys: The scorecard stopped updating
Polling requests were throttled by the provider
The scorecard polls the data provider instead of receiving pushed updates
incidents.lesson: Polling is fragile at the end of a match.

incidents.title: Buffering storm when the stream switched to 4K
incidents.desc: When 4K renditions were added for the final overs, viewers buffered for 5 minutes.
whys: Everyone buffered
The new 4K manifests were fetched from the origin by every player
Live manifests are not cached at the edge
incidents.lesson: Every new rendition repeats the problem.

incidents.title: Entitlement database CPU at 100% at the toss
incidents.desc: The entitlement database hit 100% CPU at 13:30; starts, licences and heartbeats all slowed.
whys: Entitlement queries slowed down
Every start, licence and heartbeat queried the database
Every playback start checks entitlement in the database
incidents.fix: Moved to a larger database instance.
incidents.lesson: Bigger hardware for the same pattern.

incidents.title: Subscriptions bought at the toss still inactive
incidents.desc: Viewers who paid during today's toss still cannot watch; callbacks failed and nothing re-checked them.
whys: Paid viewers cannot watch
Payment callbacks failed under load
Subscription payments are not reconciled with the payment gateway

incidents.title: Ad break overran into the first over
incidents.desc: The innings-break ads ran into the first over again today.
whys: Ads covered the first over
The break length was the hard-coded default
Ad break length is hard-coded instead of read from the live signal

incidents.title: Video not starting for many viewers at the toss
incidents.desc: At today's toss many viewers see 'Something went wrong'; start requests are timing out.
whys: Streams are not starting
Start requests wait on entitlement lookups
Every playback start checks entitlement in the database

debts.title: Serve cached entitlements from a signed playback token
debts.desc: Issue a signed token with the viewer's entitlement at login and renewal; playback, licence and heartbeat checks read the cached token instead of the database.
debts.cause: Every playback start checks entitlement in the database

debts.title: Circuit breaker and cached fallback for licence requests
debts.desc: When entitlement lookups slow down, the licence server opens a circuit breaker and falls back to the cached entitlement.

debts.title: Read ad break length from the live signal instead of hard-coded values
debts.desc: Use the cue-in and cue-out markers in the live feed to start and end every ad break.
debts.cause: Ad break length is hard-coded instead of read from the live signal

debts.title: Receive pushed score updates through a message queue
debts.desc: Subscribe to the provider's pushed match events through a message queue instead of polling every 30 seconds.
debts.cause: The scorecard polls the data provider instead of receiving pushed updates

debts.title: Reconcile subscription payments with the gateway every 5 minutes
debts.desc: Match every captured payment with an active subscription and activate any that were missed.
debts.cause: Subscription payments are not reconciled with the payment gateway

debts.title: Optimistic version checks instead of row locks for device limits
debts.desc: Track devices with an optimistic version column; heartbeats no longer lock the user row.
debts.cause: Device-limit checks lock the user row on every heartbeat

debts.title: Batch writes for chat messages, one transaction per second
debts.desc: Buffer chat messages and reactions and save them in bulk once a second.
debts.cause: Chat writes every message to the database in its own transaction

debts.title: Serve cached live manifests from the edge for two seconds
debts.desc: Cache live manifests at the edge with a 2-second lifetime and request collapsing, so the origin sees one request per edge, not one per viewer.
debts.cause: Live manifests are not cached at the edge

debts.title: Separate connection pools for playback reads and billing batch jobs
debts.desc: Renewal and billing batch jobs get their own small pool so they never starve playback and login.

debts.title: Timeouts on ad and licence calls during playback start
debts.desc: Playback start gives the ads and licence calls a strict timeout so one slow service cannot block a stream from starting.

debts.title: Graceful fallback to the cached entitlement when lookups time out
debts.desc: If the entitlement lookup times out, degrade gracefully: let a viewer with a recent valid entitlement keep watching.

debts.title: Load test the toss at 20x before the final
debts.desc: Replay a toss and final-over surge at 20 times a normal match against staging before every final.

debts.title: Tokenised manifest URLs and per-device rate limits
debts.desc: Sign every manifest and segment URL for one device and rate limit licence and manifest requests per account, so restreaming bots are cut off within seconds.

debts.title: Rate limit chat messages per viewer
debts.desc: Limit each viewer to one message every 2 seconds during live matches.
